canonical_statement: For every natural number n and every closed complex-analytic subset Z of finite-dimensional complex projective space CP^n, there is a family of homogeneous complex polynomials whose simultaneous projective zero locus is exactly Z.

canonical_formal_target.fully_explicit_expression: forall (n : Nat) (Z : Set (Stage1Instances.THMM0108.ComplexProjectiveSpace n)), Stage1Instances.THMM0108.IsClosedComplexAnalyticProjectiveSubset Z -> Stage1Instances.THMM0108.IsHomogeneousPolynomialCutOut Z

domain_and_universes: n : Nat; HomogeneousCoordinates n = Fin (n + 1) -> Complex; ComplexProjectiveSpace n is the quotient Projectivization Complex (HomogeneousCoordinates n); all carriers are in universe 0 and the target is Prop.
hypotheses: the quotient preimage of Z in the nonzero homogeneous-coordinate cone is closed
around every point of Z, that preimage is locally the common zero locus of finitely many complex-analytic functions
conclusion: There exists one family of homogeneous multivariate polynomials over Complex whose simultaneous zeros on all nonzero homogeneous-coordinate representatives are exactly Z.
